notes:
DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card lists helper PythonObjectDriver (family python-object), but the upstream temi.api:Temi is an async WebSocket client whose commands are dynamic JSON requests; the package is a direct Driver over that class with native.py as the hardware factory. No hardware was attached or run, and nothing here ran on a robot. The package is model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json reviewed_by is null), so the loader refuses the hardware backend at R2. The documented API has no getter (src/temi/README.md:45-62), so there are no reads or writes; the driver binds actions only. Turn and raise_head are NOT COVERED: the clone states no unit or range for turn (README.md:57-59) and no unit for the screen tilt (README.md:60-61), so a numeric input would be unsourced; no numeric Limit or operator_required bound exists, which is why G8 reports SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE (there is no envelope to test). Events/callbacks are NOT COVERED because the clone documents no event names. The stop command is an inference: README.md:37-43 says a timed-out goto may keep walking and that the caller can command Temi to stop, but the API table does not name the stop command; the safe-state action and @estop send {"command": "stop"}. The clone documents no hardware emergency-stop reference, so estop_physical_ref is not declared; SAFE-045 is met by the x-cap.tongji-cdi.stop.v1 safe-state action. The fake's canned answer "yes" and successful goto are placeholders, not facts. interface is documented only by the example at src/temi/api.py:142, not by the API table.

catalogue_requests.reason: cap.motion.mobile_base.v1 takes linear_velocity, angular_velocity and duration_s, but the Temi API documents only goto(location) to a saved location (src/temi/README.md:50-68); no velocity or duration command is documented, so the class cannot express this motion.
The catalogue has no speech or text-to-speech class; the Temi speak command takes a sentence (src/temi/README.md:16-31).
The catalogue has no speech-recognition or dialogue class; the Temi ask command returns the recognized answer (src/temi/README.md:33-48).
The catalogue has no display or user-interface class; the upstream example opens a URL on the Temi screen with interface(url=...) (src/temi/api.py:142).
cap.motion.stop.v1 declares an optional deceleration in m/s2, but the Temi stop command takes no parameter (README.md:37-43); binding the class would advertise a field the device cannot use.
